policy: No dependency enters production without sandbox benchmark and before/after evidence.

candidates.purpose: Real-time equities WebSocket market data and future paper-trading adapter
candidates.latencySuitability: HIGH with appropriate Alpaca market-data entitlement
candidates.documentationTests: Strong docs; official streaming examples; upstream test suite present
candidates.securityNotes: Requires API credentials; secrets must remain in GitHub Actions secrets. Feed entitlement/coverage must be verified before using as truth.
candidates.lookAheadRisk: LOW for live stream; backtests must preserve exchange timestamps and avoid consolidated-bar leakage
candidates.costDataRequirements: Account/API keys required; usable coverage and SIP/IEX entitlement depend on plan
candidates.reason: Best current candidate to replace polling for trades/quotes when credentials and coverage are proven; do not integrate production until extended-hours coverage/latency benchmark beats Yahoo polling.

candidates.purpose: Current SEC filings, typed filing parsing, XBRL, offering/dilution and insider-event extraction
candidates.latencySuitability: HIGH for SEC-event lane; current filings are updated every few minutes
candidates.maintenance: Very active; pushed 2026-08-26; 2.6k+ stars; 33 open issues
candidates.documentationTests: Excellent docs; 1000+ verification tests claimed; typed APIs and current-filings examples
candidates.securityNotes: No API key required. Must set compliant SEC User-Agent and rate limiting. Cache responses to avoid SEC throttling.
candidates.lookAheadRisk: MEDIUM in replay unless SEC acceptance timestamp, not filing date alone, is stored and used
candidates.costDataRequirements: Free SEC EDGAR; dependencies include pandas/pyarrow/lxml/httpx and others
candidates.reason: Strongest candidate for catalyst clock and dilution detection; benchmark dependency weight and SEC reliability against current urllib parser before integration.

candidates.purpose: Deterministic event-driven replay/backtesting and production-grade trading-engine patterns
candidates.maintenance: Extremely active; pushed 2026-08-26; 27k+ stars; Rust-native core
candidates.securityNotes: Large dependency/architecture surface; avoid embedding directly into lightweight GitHub Pages path.
candidates.lookAheadRisk: LOW if event timestamps and replay ordering are configured correctly; powerful framework reduces accidental temporal leakage
candidates.costDataRequirements: Framework is open source; adapters/data feeds may require paid services
candidates.reason: Use deterministic event ordering, replay and component-boundary patterns for TAGX Missed-Mover Replay; direct integration is disproportionate to current architecture.

candidates.purpose: Semantic parsing of SEC HTML into document trees
candidates.maintenance: Repository explicitly states it is no longer maintained
candidates.documentationTests: Historically good semantic parser and separate test-data project
candidates.securityNotes: Unmaintained parsing dependency increases supply-chain and compatibility risk
candidates.lookAheadRisk: LOW by itself; replay timestamp discipline still required
candidates.reason: Do not add an unmaintained parser when edgartools is actively maintained and better aligned with current-filings needs.
